title: The Shortest Document That Publishes

# The Shortest Document That Publishes

## One heading

One paragraph, and nothing else. The point of this document is the front matter
it does not have: no doc_type, no version, no owner, no revisions, no
classification. Every one of those has to fall back to a default, and the cover
and the control tables have to look right anyway.

## A second heading

So the contents list has two entries rather than one.
